source_file.Description: Original EDF in the PhysioNet release (PNxx/<file>).

start_time_of_day.Description: Start clock time from the EDF header (hh:mm:ss, local time).

edf_header_date.Description: Start date in the EDF header as released. The release de-identified all dates (every file reads 01.01.yy), so it is not the real recording date.
